newsitem.title: FRANCE: French growth could surpass 2.5 pct - Trichet.
newsitem.headline: French growth could surpass 2.5 pct - Trichet.

text.p: Bank of France governor Jean-Claude Trichet said on Tuesday the Bank of France's monetary policy council had set its policy against "a background of potential growth for the French economy of around 2.5 percent per year".
"We consider this the average growth of our economy in the medium term, and it could be exceeded given that we have a potential to catch up in the medium-term," Trichet told a news conference.
